glosses: to offend, to hurt someone's feelings, to abuse, to insult
To cause (a person or animal) physical pain and/or injury.

examples.text: If anybody hurts my little brother, I will get upset.
This injection might hurt a little. Your arm will be hurting you for a while.
He was deeply hurt he hadn’t been invited.
The insult hurt.
Does your leg still hurt? / It is starting to feel better.

glosses: To damage, harm, impair, undermine, impede.

examples.text: This latest gaffe hurts the legislator’s reelection prospects still further.
Copying and pasting identical portions of source code hurts maintainability, because the programmer has to keep all those copies synchronized.
It wouldn't hurt to check the weather forecast and find out if it's going to rain.
